notes: Track creation validates staged media, allocates Track ObjectId and both UUID keys, then durably inserts an uploading MediaOperation with relative stage directory and validated audio/image metadata before publishing either file.

steps.title: Transactional creation and delete ordering

checks.result: pass: 5 files, 29 replica-set integration tests; includes 3 concurrent create/delete races with cleanup reconciliation

checks.command: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run build
checks.result: pass
pass; OpenAPI/client types remain synchronized

notes: Added Track.commentWriteRevision. Comment creation conditionally increments it on an active Track and inserts the Comment in one snapshot/majority transaction. Track deletion already updates lifecycle transactionally on the same document, forcing the two operations to serialize.

Comment create/delete use a manual transaction loop with a maximum of three attempts for TransientTransactionError and up to three commit attempts for UnknownTransactionCommitResult. Application, filesystem and callback side effects are outside transaction callbacks.

Individual comment deletion now participates in the same parent revision/lifecycle protocol and returns 404 when the parent is no longer active. Quarantined comments remain undeletable through normal API.

Replica-set integration test races comment creation against track deletion three times, then runs maintenance and confirms no comment remains under the deleting/deleted parent. No original database was changed.

notes: Versioned guest snapshot persistence is used only with Web Locks and BroadcastChannel. Exclusive writes use revision checks and retry identity; cross-tab changes trigger reload. Unsupported/denied storage keeps an explicit per-tab unsaved in-memory queue.

Guest queues re-resolve IDs before playback. Corrupt and unknown-version data is quarantined with an explicit reset action; offline resolution retains saved bytes and does not mark cached tracks playable.
